Marta (product): SignalShore asked for a concise private-deploy roadmap: customer-managed networking, deterministic upgrade windows, minimal IP churn, and an explicit rollback they can run. Need acceptance tests + cost estimate by EOW.
Ken (eng-runtime): I propose 2 phases. Phase 1 (Q3): managed peering/BGP, DNS/TLS handoff automation, canary + controlled-swap (mirror->ramp) and a documented rollback. Est 2-3w. Phase 2 (Q4): strict IP pinning (allocator/CNI changes), airgap/offline installer improvements. Est 5-8w.
Sofia (field): SignalShore NetOps requires <30s visible disruption and KMS-backed keys. They prefer BGP VIP handoff but accept controlled DNS if we can demonstrate it in staging. Also they want a clear SLA for upgrade windows.
Alex (solutions): For Phase 1 we can offer a "controlled-swap" flow: mirror traffic to new nodes, warm caches, then ramp traffic weight and finalize DNS/TLS cutover. We'll provide a runbook and a small harness. Example verify/promote commands: ```
# health check
curl -H \"Host: signal-canary\" https://private.signal/health
# promote
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/promote -d '{\"tenant\":\"signal-canary\"}'
# rollback
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/rollback -d '{\"tenant\":\"signal-canary\"}'
```
Ken (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: add feature flags: "vip_swap_mode": "bgp|dns|mirror" and "ip_pin": "soft|strict". Strict requires allocator/CNI changes (Phase 2). Also installer must accept customer route tables; I'll open RFC today.
Marta (product): Proposed deliverables for Phase 1: BGP/peering support, DNS/TLS handoff automation, controlled-swap APIs, canary + rollback playbook, KMS/audit logs, and acceptance test checklist. Phase 2 to follow after initial rollouts. Agree to align SLA wording with legal/finance.
Sofia (field): SignalShore will accept Phase 1 if we include: (1) NetOps handoff doc, (2) staged playbook they can run, (3) a billing estimate for reserved capacity during upgrade windows. I'll capture exact SLA numbers by Wed.
handoff-bot: Runbook stub created: /docs/private-deploys/signalshore-handoff.md. Owner: Alex. Reviewers: Ken, Sofia.
Marta (product): Action items: Alex to deliver runbook + harness by Tue, Ken to publish RFC and prototype vip_swap_mode by Thu, Sofia to confirm SLA thresholds and cost constraints by Wed. We'll present Phase 1 plan at Friday steering and mark Phase 2 as conditional on telemetry from initial customers. If anything slips, escalate to PM leadership.
